notes.title: Update (June 19, 2025): Parallax effect anchoring to player, spawn adjustments
notes.notes:
The parallax effect for the level background is now anchored to the player when using the camera-behind-player control/camera mode. This should eliminate nausea experienced by some players with this camera mode.
 Made various minor adjustments to the spawn percentages of randomly spawning weapons.

notes.title: Update (September 3, 2024): New Weapon, Musket Uzi, and Various Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Added a new weapon: Musket Uzi. This powerful new weapon can now be found throughout the game.
Added an information text box that displays which button can be used to skip dialogue.
Fixed an issue where multiple dialogue transition sounds would overlap when skipping dialogue.
Fixed a bug where UI elements were visible over the red screen during Jarold's scene.
Fixed a bug where an axe would occasionally spawn for the player during non-combat scenes.

notes.title: UPDATE INBOUND!
notes.notes:
Good news, space vikings! Since the release last year, we’ve been committed to improving the game in many ways. Many bugs have been fixed, and many small details fine-tuned. But soon it’s time for a bigger update!

This time, we will introduce a new batch of weapons and special devices! What they exactly are will be revealed in the near future when the update lands… Here’s a small sneak peek.

notes.title: Update (Mar 12, 2024): New Music, Boost to Plasma Projectiles & Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Extended the lifetime of plasma projectiles after they bounce off surfaces.
 Changed music for Arena Mode.
 Fixed an issue where player could talk with non-existent entity in the Cyonpolis Arena.
 Fixed a bug that erroneously awarded achievements for completing a level if the player died simultaneously with the last NPC.
 Fixed a graphical glitch involving a solitary white pixel visible in a single frame of the NPC soldier's gunpowder pistol animation sequence.
 Optimized audio effect file loading to occur in the background, enhancing performance on lower-end machines.

notes.title: Update (Feb 24, 2024): New achievements & Reticle size adjustments
notes.notes:
Added 2 new achievements
 Adjusted aiming reticle sizing for various resolutions and window sizes

notes.title: Update (Jan 15, 2024) Difficulty selection menu & Thrown projectile adjustments
notes.notes:
Added a difficulty selection menu that shows after clicking "new game".
 Slightly re-balanced different thrown projectile speeds.

notes.title: Update (Jan 7, 2024): Bugfixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
Slight adjustments to various collider sizes.
 Reactivating dialogue with NPC no longer requires double click.
 Fixed short period of Lars not having a collider in chapter 2.
 Fixed unintentional camera stutter while Myrcia is searching in chapter 8.
 Fixed "12 is better in 6" achievement being unlockable during temporary immortality.

notes.title: Update (Jan 1, 2024): Various Improvements
notes.notes:
The storytelling slideshow at the beginning of Chapter 2 is now skippable with the dialog skipping key.
 Door movement speed and extent of movement when hit by various projectiles have been rebalanced.
 Rare occasions where NPCs moved towards doors so quickly that they appeared to go through the door instead of opening it are now fixed.
 Holding the key to skip dialog no longer triggers device use bound to the same key.

notes.title: Update (Dec 17, 2023): Windowed Mode
notes.notes: Video options now include option to run the game in windowed mode.

notes.title: Update (Dec 2, 2023): Camera rotation
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=8-lobIyilO4;full][/previewyoutube]
You can now rotate the camera freely and lock it to any position.

Keyboard:

[1] to rotate left
[2] to reset rotation
[3] to rotate right

Gamepad (XBOX controller example):

[directional pad left] to rotate left
[directional pad right] to rotate right
[X] to reset rotation
